notes: Product Image Studio: upload or take one product photo, then generate nine marketplace-ready images automatically.
Automatic background removal plus auto background, scene and holiday template matching.
Edit every image individually: move, scale and rotate the cut-out product, titles, logo and stickers.
Templates are organised into background, scene and holiday groups for quick restyling.
Text supports multiple fonts, bold, colour, outline, gradient, glow, shadow and vertical writing.
Save all nine images locally, or upload them straight back to the product photos in one tap.
